purpose: Make the current Primary Chat + worker-autonomy state reconstructable without relying on one ChatGPT conversation or human recap. This file does not replace CURRENT, Work Graph, Current Tree, Guide, worker contracts, Design DNA, portfolio owners or experiment evidence.

current_truth.worker_liveness_rule: Do not infer shell liveness from ACTIVE/PARKED/current_job_id; only recent durable signals count.
current_truth.primary_chat_goal: Human should converse through Primary Chat; durable work is routed by CURRENT; workers are fungible execution shells; results return to Primary Chat without human task routing.

latest_ingress_canary.human_text: CANARY: respondé PONG. No hagas cambios de producto.

ux_repair.goal: Message behaves like a normal chat send: immediate local echo, visible sending state, button lock, no accidental duplicate submit, explicit sent/error state.
ux_repair.note: Do not claim served end-to-end UX PASS until representative browser evidence verifies these bytes.

primary_chat_control_loop_target.principle: Primary Chat should not merely enqueue raw text. For substantial work it should first project a compact proposed execution plan, let the human approve or edit it, then materialize ordinary durable work through existing owners and CURRENT.

content: goal interpreted from the human message
dependencies and what can run in parallel
which items are real product work versus bounded worker-improvement experiments
definition of done and evidence expected
what the human will see while it runs
proposal_before_execution.ui: compact summary plus expandable details/widgets; avoid giant prose dumps

human_gate.rule: Approval authorizes the proposed bounded plan; it does not let the human assign individual workers or bypass CURRENT authority.

after_approval.materialization: Reuse Objective/Portfolio/Guide/Metabolism and existing portfolio-derived work owners; do not create a parallel plan queue.
after_approval.allocation: CURRENT/claim frontier decides which compatible worker gets each unit.
after_approval.parallelism: Independent workstreams may be materialized concurrently; dependencies remain gated. Do not serialize independent useful work merely because one worker exists.
after_approval.capacity_request: Primary Chat states the exact number of fresh worker shells useful now and shows one universal /wc prompt to copy. Human opens capacity, not routed tasks.
after_approval.worker_prompt_rule: Every shell receives the same universal /wc launcher; no per-worker task prompt or numbering.
after_approval.resident_reuse: A productive worker may continue through E8/SUBMIT_NEXT instead of requiring one new chat per task.

minimum_widgets: overall plan percentage derived from durable evidence
recent real worker signals rather than ACTIVE labels
current bottleneck and whether more worker capacity would help
live_progress.update_rule: Progress derives from durable claims/returns/evidence and refreshes automatically; never fake liveness or percentage from prose.

result_flow.worker_result: Workers persist RETURN/evidence; integration owners reduce results and successors.
result_flow.primary_chat_result: Primary Chat publishes the useful synthesized answer/result in the same conversation, not merely a path or worker log.
result_flow.temporary_control_chat_handoff: Until Primary Chat reaches response quality and reliability comparable to the controlling AI chat, expose a copyable result/context block that can be pasted back into a ChatGPT control shell for review. This is transitional, not the desired final UX.
result_flow.approval_after_result: When a result needs human acceptance before promotion or a next wave, show the exact decision and buttons/options in Primary Chat.

quality_evaluation.purpose: Use real Primary Chat requests to evaluate planning quality as well as worker mechanics.
questions: Did the planner understand the organism and reuse existing owners?
Did it identify genuinely parallel workstreams?
Did it avoid unnecessary human routing and serial bottlenecks?
Did it distinguish product work from experiments to improve worker capability?
Did it request only useful worker capacity?
Did the final synthesis answer the human as well as the controlling AI chat would?
quality_evaluation.evolution_rule: Weak planning, allocation, verification or worker stages are improved through bounded experiments against existing benchmarks and ratchets, not by silently redesigning CURRENT.

primary_chat_control_loop_target.future_scale: Once one approved plan can reliably execute end-to-end, the same loop should support multiple projects, visual work, ideas and worker-evolution experiments in parallel, bounded by real dependencies and available shells rather than one-chat-at-a-time sequencing.

architecture_layers.role: Primary Chat captures human objective, proposes/clarifies substantial plans, records approval and shows concise responses/progress. Human does not route individual worker tasks.
Existing Objective/Portfolio/Guide/Metabolism mechanisms turn goals and returns into grounded durable work and successors. Planning is above workers and must not become a parallel scheduler.
PROMETEO_ARCHITECTURE_WORK_GRAPH_V1_1 + current allocator/claim frontier choose compatible work. POOL is normal capacity; RUN is only a bounded experiment fixture.
Fresh fungible shell follows /wc/ and WORKER_PIPELINE_V1 E0-E9: envelope, identity, assign, exact context, plan lock, produce, verify, durable return, reallocate, exam/close.
Durable RETURN/evidence is integrated by existing Guide/Metabolism/portfolio owners; safe successors are materialized; Primary Chat projects the relevant answer.

Worker improvement happens through bounded RUN/lab experiments that vary a stage/rule, benchmark against frozen baselines, and promote only with durable evidence. Lab candidates never silently become CURRENT.

lab_boundary.rule: Experimentos contains candidate providers, worker-lab, STT and other lab evidence. It is reusable evidence/capability exploration, not Prometeo authority. Reuse findings through existing Prometeo owners instead of importing a parallel scheduler/provider/current.

next_sequence: Finish one real Primary Chat -> CURRENT -> fresh /wc worker -> durable RETURN -> Primary Chat PONG canary without human task routing.
Verify served UX: one tap produces immediate local echo/sending state, prevents duplicate submit, and resolves to sent/error visibly.

Make the next substantial Primary Chat interaction exercise the proposal -> human approval -> durable materialization -> exact capacity request -> CURRENT allocation -> live progress -> synthesized result loop.
Reconcile the duplicate canary work items through existing allocator/return/integration semantics; do not hand-delete historical evidence.

Restore or replace the degraded private ingress storage layer only within the existing BRIDGE_CONTRACT. Supabase is not allowed to become a mandatory completion dependency merely because it was the first implementation.
Once normal non-canary private ingress and response projection are certified, make Primary Chat the normal human interface and treat direct ChatGPT control chat as recovery/bootstrap only.

Use POOL for useful project capacity. Use bounded RUN experiments to improve individual worker pipeline stages, prompts, capability matching, verification, reallocation, exit audits and provider adapters.
Aggregate real E9 exit_audit_v1 evidence to find time/failure hotspots; evolve only the weak stage instead of redesigning the whole worker.
Recover ideas/plans through Current Tree/portfolio/chat recovery owners and materialize them as ordinary durable work. Do not depend on this chat transcript to remember them.
immediate_human_action: Launch exactly one fresh universal /wc worker with the published universal launcher and do not route it. This validates that CURRENT can discover the already durable PONG canary. Do not launch a large pool until this end-to-end return appears in Primary Chat.
success_condition: The system is no longer chat-dependent when a new shell can recover this lineage, a human can issue a normal private request in Primary Chat, receive a reviewable proposed plan for substantial work, approve it, CURRENT can route the resulting durable work without human task selection, fresh workers can execute/reallocate under existing contracts, live progress reflects durable evidence, and the useful verified result appears back in Primary Chat.
forbidden_regressions: treating workers as daemons because a UI says ACTIVE
publishing raw private chat text or credentials
making Supabase mandatory for all worker completion
letting lab experiments silently replace CURRENT
losing ideas/plans because a ChatGPT thread ended
